## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sampannasīla Sutta* (“Accomplishment in Ethics,” also titled *Sampannasīlasutta*) is the 111th discourse of the *Itivuttaka*, situated in the fourth division (*Catukkanipāta*, sutta 4.12; PTS It 118). The discourse addresses the practice of virtue, considering what further spiritual work remains to be done once an individual is consummate in moral conduct.

Citations of “Itivuttaka 111” in modern secondary scholarship frequently point to page 111 of the Pali Text Society edition (which contains the *Bahukāra Sutta*, Iti 107, concerning mutual support between monastics and the laity) rather than sutta 111 itself.
